recent_articles.title: IHC issues notices to CDA in appeals by flat owners, BoP over One Constitution Avenue lease - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A division bench of the Islamabad High Court issued notices to the **Capital Development Authority (CDA)** in response to intra-court appeals filed by apartment owners and the Bank of Punjab (BoP). The appeals challenge a previous single-member bench's decision to cancel the lease of the One Constitution Avenue project, citing potential violations of third-party rights.  The court adjourned further hearing on the matter pending a response from the **CDA** and a final decision by the cabinet regarding the issue.

recent_articles.title: Karachi police arrest 'highly wanted' female drug lord - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in **Karachi** arrested Anmol alias Pinki, a highly wanted woman accused of supplying cocaine and narcotics across the city.  The arrest followed a joint operation by Garden Police Station and a civilian intelligence agency. During the raid, police recovered a pistol, cocaine worth millions of rupees, chemicals, and other narcotics from her possession. **Anmol** allegedly operated an organized network for drug dealing and used female riders to protect her operations. The accused's brothers, Nasir and Shaukat, are also involved in the narcotics trade.  The case is being investigated under the Sindh Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2024, and the Sindh Arms Act, 2013. **Karachi** Additional Inspector General (AIG) Azad Khan has ordered an inquiry into the incident where **Anmol** was presented in court without handcuffs, while **Sindh** Home Minister Ziaul Hassan Lanjar has also taken strict notice of the matter.
